name: The Way Love Goes
source:
It's been over ten years since you left your home town. At that time it wouldn't have been an understatement if someone called you a lazy turd. Cause that's exactly what you were. At one point you're parents were so fed up, they kicked your ass to the curb. After struggling for a long time to get both your feet on the ground, you got a spot in a University and worked as manager for a big company for the past five years. Not having seen your parents for a long time, a few months ago you learned they got divorced and both left to different countries for good. Strangely enough though, they must've heard of your achievements and that made them so proud, they left you a considerable amount of money before they left. A few weeks ago, your mom's best friend Megan then contacted you out of the blue, wanting to tell you why your parents divorced and inviting you over for a few weeks. As you haven't had seen her and her daughters in so long and because you had a little crush on her when you were young, you agreed to come visit. This is where your story begins.
[from adugames]
translation:
你离开家乡已经十多年了。那个时候，如果有人说你是个懒惰的废物，那也不算轻描淡写。因为那正是你本来的样子。有一次，你的父母受够了，他们把你踢到了路边。经过很长一段时间的努力，你终于进入了大学，并在一家大公司担任了五年的经理。很长一段时间没有见到你的父母，几个月前你得知他们离婚了，并且永远离开了不同的国家。但奇怪的是，他们一定听说过你的成就，这让他们感到非常自豪，他们在离开之前给你留下了一大笔钱。几周前，你妈妈最好的朋友梅根突然联系你，想告诉你你父母离婚的原因，并邀请你过来住几个星期。因为你已经很久没有见到她和她的女儿们了，而且因为你年轻的时候对她有一点迷恋，所以你同意来看望她。这就是你的故事开始的地方。
[来自阿杜游戏]
